correctness.rationale: For the stationary Markov process with generator D fʺ+r(f(cx)-f(x)), |c|=exp(-ε/2)∈(0,1), D,r>0, synchronous coupling gives uniqueness and a two-sided stochastic integral exists in L². Stationary Fourier product equals independent Laplace sum with geometric scales. With Y_ε=ε sqrt(r/D)X, ε log E exp(θY_ε/ε)=εΣ_{j≥0}-log(1-θ²e^{-jε}) for |θ|<1, bounded between Li₂(θ²) and Li₂(θ²)+ε log(1/(1-θ²)) by monotone Riemann sums. Limiting pressure derivative -2log(1-θ²)/θ is strictly increasing onto all R, so interior tilts give concentrated lower bounds; finite-cover Chernoff + exponential tightness establish full LDP speed 1/ε with even strict-convex Legendre rate. Series invert to I(y)=y²/4-y⁴/64+O(y⁶) near zero, I(y)=|y|-π²/6+exp(-|y|/2)+O(|y|exp(-|y|)) for large y, and I(y)<y²/4 for y≠0. Bounded pressure/rate comparisons passed 19 independent numerical checks. No finite-ε uniform tail prefactors are claimed.
